description: Cs₂NaAl₃F₁₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Cs is bonded in a 15-coordinate geometry to fifteen F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.06-3.61 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.33 Å. Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-51°. There are two shorter (1.78 Å) and four longer (1.86 Å) Al-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Cs and two equivalent Al atoms.
